title: How does the interaction of macroprudential and monetary policies affect cross-border bank lending?
abstract: We combine a rarely accessed BIS database on cross-border lending flows with cross-country data on macroprudential regulations. We find significant interactions between the monetary policy of major international currency issuers (USD, EUR and JPY) and macroprudential policies in source (home) lending banking systems. Consistent with the bank lending channel, macroprudential easing in a home country amplifies the effect of currency issuers' monetary policy on lending. For instance, UK macroprudential easing amplifies the negative impact of US monetary policy tightening on USD-denominated cross-border bank lending outflows from UK banks. Vice versa, tighter macroprudential policy mitigates these effects.
